mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact cone numerator, affine convex blending, scale/margin bounds and two different vacuum coefficient limits for a new occupied-phase center patch.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact positive real symbolic rational functions, radicals, limits and rational control points.
mathematics.conventions: c=1; h denotes material effective inertia h_s(1-s_s^2), not bare enthalpy; fixed positive-density phase and pure-electric background for cone test.

bounds.blend_controls: h/D0^2=1/1000,1,1000; E=3a/4; four interpolation weights each; 12 bounded controls
bounds.resources: 45 second wall cap,35 CPU seconds,one numerical-library thread

non_claims: The cutoff is a chosen constitutive postulate, not derived microphysics.
No continuous vacuum coefficient extension, uniform tail neighborhood, nonlinear stability, or full metric solution.
Finite blend controls do not replace the analytic convexity and scale inequalities.
